description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended nivolumab, within its marketing authorisation, with platinum- and fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy, as an option for untreated HER2-negative, advanced or metastatic gastric, gastro-oesophageal junction or oesophageal adenocarcinoma in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 with a combined positive score (CPS) of 5 or more. Nivolumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
